description: Two gesture memories for Evocation with separate transforms and a morph between them, and it goes immediately to the right of the Evocation it belongs to

params.text: Moves between the two transformed memories, all of A at the bottom and all of B at the top, crossfading matching points of the two contours
Low-pass smooths the selected memory in both directions at once, so hand jitter softens without the contour shifting earlier or later
Replaces the selected memory's detail with fewer straight segments, low settings keeping the hand and high settings leaving the geometry
Chooses which memory the next finished Evocation recording lands in, and which one the transform controls edit
Flips the selected memory in time before it is morphed, which is separate from Evocation's own loop direction
Folds the selected memory into the first half of its length and plays it back out through the second, so it ends where it started
Scales the selected transformed memory so its highest point reaches full

inputs.text: Adds to the morph knob, 10V covering the whole span from A to B and clamping at the ends; only the first channel is read

outputs.text: The transformed memory A on its own, 0-10V
The transformed memory B on its own, 0-10V
The current morph between the two transformed memories, 0-10V

notes: it shows AWAITING EVOCATION and does nothing until an Evocation is the module immediately to its left; a gap or another module between them breaks the link
Evocation stays the performer: it records the gesture and supplies the triggers, loop direction, loop window, phase, clock fit and polyphony that these outputs follow
a memory is written when a finished Evocation recording arrives, and by default the selector then moves to the other memory ready for the next take
transforms never rewrite the stored take, so any of them can be changed or reset later
the three jacks here are fixed at 0-10V and ignore Evocation's per-lane voltage range, invert and peak normalization
it is inactive while Evocation is in ADSR mode, and both memories survive that
menu: Alternate A/B after each capture — moves the record target to the other memory after each successful new take
Capture Evocation gesture — copies the gesture Evocation currently holds straight into the selected memory
Write protect — locks that memory against capture, clearing, copying into it and swapping, while leaving its transforms editable
Reset transforms — returns reverse, palindrome, smooth, simplify and normalize to neutral for the selected memory
Swap A and B — exchanges the two memories, and is refused unless both are unlocked
Show on screen — chooses which memory's source trace the screen draws

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
